senses.gloss: m. (תרד, cmp. טָרַד) confused, senseless person, fool, madman.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 25b:11">Zeb. 25ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="V00922"><he>תְּרָארָא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 541:5">Yalk. Lev. 541</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:2">B. Mets. 20ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="V00922"><he>תְּרָאדָא</he></cite>; Ms. F. <cite ref="V00922"><he>תְּרָארָא</he></cite>).

B. Kam. 105ᵇ תרדא Ms. M. (ed. תדורא; Ms. H. תארארא, marginal correct. תררא; Ms. R. טָרוֹדָא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Ar. תרארא).—[Ar. תררא, תרארא, fr. ריר, one that lets his spittle run over his beard, madman.—Sachs Beitr. I, p. 107, referring to preced. w., silly person, cmp. Lat. bliteus.]
